record.question: What is the dose of albendazole for a 3 year old child to be given at National Deworming Day as per National Health Mission (NHM) guideline?
record.explanation: Answer D: 400 mg. NHM National Deworming Day guidance gives children aged 2–19 years one full 400 mg albendazole tablet; a 3-year-old therefore receives 400 mg under that protocol. Reference: https://www.nhm.gov.in/images/pdf/NDD/Guidelines/NDD_Operational_Guidelines.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
